upgrade.agents: Need more AI agents? EzyChat Enterprise has one AI agent for each WhatsApp number.
upgrade.numbers: Need more WhatsApp numbers? EzyChat Enterprise links several numbers to one team inbox.
upgrade.about: More WhatsApp numbers and AI agents, with support from Anchor Sprint.

whatsappLink.title: How does linking WhatsApp work?
whatsappLink.body: EzyChat joins your WhatsApp as a linked device, the same way WhatsApp Web does. Your phone keeps the number and keeps working; your team replies from EzyChat. Only the last few days of chat history come in.
whatsappLink.note: Open WhatsApp on the phone at least once every 14 days, or WhatsApp signs the linked device out.

aiConnection.title: Why does the AI need a connection?
aiConnection.body: EzyChat has no AI of its own. It uses ChatGPT or Claude through your own account, so the messages go straight to that service and you control the cost.
aiConnection.step1: Sign in with ChatGPT: the easiest. Uses your ChatGPT plan, no key to copy.
aiConnection.step2: OpenAI API key: pay OpenAI for what the AI uses.
aiConnection.step3: Claude API key: pay Anthropic for what the AI uses.
aiConnection.note: Not sure? Start with Sign in with ChatGPT. You can switch later; your AI setup stays.

apiKey.title: What is an API key?
apiKey.body: A long secret code, like a password, that lets EzyChat use OpenAI on your account. OpenAI bills that account for what the AI uses (pay as you go, separate from a ChatGPT Plus plan).
apiKey.step1: Go to platform.openai.com and sign in, or create an account.
apiKey.step2: Open Settings → Billing and add a payment method or credit.
apiKey.step3: Open API keys → Create new secret key. Name it EzyChat.
apiKey.step4: Copy the key (it starts with sk-) and paste it here. OpenAI shows it only once.
apiKey.note: Keep it private like a password. EzyChat stores it encrypted on this computer. No key? Use Sign in with ChatGPT instead.

claudeKey.title: What is a Claude API key?
claudeKey.body: A long secret code, like a password, that lets EzyChat use Claude on your Anthropic account. Anthropic bills that account for what the AI uses (pay as you go, separate from a Claude Pro plan).
claudeKey.step1: Go to console.anthropic.com and sign in, or create an account.
claudeKey.step2: Open Settings → Billing and add credit.
claudeKey.step3: Open API keys → Create key. Name it EzyChat.
claudeKey.step4: Copy the key (it starts with sk-ant-) and paste it here. Anthropic shows it only once.
claudeKey.note: Keep it private like a password. EzyChat stores it encrypted on this computer.

aiModel.title: What is a model?
aiModel.body: The model is the version of the AI. Larger models write better answers but are slower and cost more per message; smaller ones are fast and cheap.
aiModel.note: Keep the recommended choice unless you have a reason to change it.

businessContext.title: What is Business context?
businessContext.body: What the AI knows about your business: products, prices, opening hours, delivery areas, policies and common questions. The AI answers only from this; when something is missing, it hands the chat to your team.
businessContext.step1: Paste your price list, menu or FAQ as text, or upload a PDF or Word file.
businessContext.step2: Write it the way you would brief a new staff member.
businessContext.step3: Update it when prices or hours change.

instructions.title: What is the role?
instructions.body: The role tells the AI how to behave: its tone, language, what to ask customers and what to avoid. Think of it as the job description of your AI staff.
instructions.note: Facts like prices and hours go in Business context, not here.

handoff.title: What is a hand-over?
handoff.body: A hand-over is when the AI stops and passes the chat to a person on your team, who gets a notification. Hand-over rules list when that must happen, for example complaints, refunds or custom orders.
handoff.note: The customer is told a team member will reply. Anyone on the team can also take over a chat at any time.

tryIt.title: What is Try it?
tryIt.body: A practice chat. Type what a customer might say and see how the AI would answer. Nothing is sent to WhatsApp and no chat changes.

voice.title: What is voice note transcription?
voice.body: It turns customers' voice notes into text, so the AI and your team can read them.
voice.step1: On this computer: a one-time download, free, and the audio never leaves the computer.
voice.step2: In the cloud: faster, uses your OpenAI API key and is billed by OpenAI.
voice.note: Without either, voice notes still arrive; the AI hands them to your team.

tunnel.title: What is phone access?
tunnel.body: EzyChat runs on this computer. Phone access gives it a secure web address through Cloudflare (a free service), so your team can open the inbox on their phones from anywhere. This link is called a tunnel.
tunnel.note: The address works only while this computer is on and EzyChat is running.

lan.title: What is LAN access?
lan.body: It lets phones and computers on the same Wi-Fi or office network open the inbox, without going through the internet.
lan.note: LAN traffic is not encrypted. Turn it on only on a network you trust; use phone access for anywhere else.

mcp.title: What is AI assistant access?
mcp.body: It lets an AI app you already use, like Claude or ChatGPT, read your inbox and help you: summarise chats, check numbers, improve your AI agent. MCP is the standard these apps use to connect to other tools.
mcp.note: It stays off until you turn it on, and you choose what each app may do.

accessToken.title: What is an access token?
accessToken.body: A secret code that a developer tool on your computer uses to prove it may use your inbox. Apps like claude.ai and ChatGPT sign in by themselves and need no token.
accessToken.note: Copy it once and keep it private. Revoke it here to cut access at once.

connectors.title: What is a connector?
connectors.body: A connector lets your AI agent use another app for you, for example check free times in Google Calendar and book an appointment.
connectors.note: Look-ups are on once connected; anything that changes data stays off until you turn it on.
